title: Clean Meeting
description: Control transcript: every question is answered, every point acknowledged, every topic closed. Expected output: zero gaps.

transcript.speaker: Meera
transcript.text: Let us start sprint planning. What is the team capacity this sprint?

transcript.speaker: Tanvi
transcript.text: I have twelve story points free after the incident work.

transcript.speaker: Meera
transcript.text: Great. Which items go into the sprint first?

transcript.speaker: Tanvi
transcript.text: The payment retry bug should be first, it blocks customers.

transcript.speaker: Meera
transcript.text: Do we agree the payment retry bug is the top item?

transcript.speaker: Tanvi
transcript.text: To clarify, does the retry bug include the webhook fix?

transcript.speaker: Vikram
transcript.text: Yes, the webhook fix is inside the same ticket.

transcript.speaker: Meera
transcript.text: So we are agreed - payment retry and webhook fix are item one. Decision is confirmed.

transcript.speaker: Nikhil
transcript.text: I will take the webhook fix if nobody else wants it.

transcript.speaker: Meera
transcript.text: That is all from me. To conclude, we are done.
